text:
ada-partnerships: quick sync — CloudVendorX marketplace starter IAC. We need a small, audited repo showing k8s inference + autoscaling + optional private networking + KMS/HSM notes. Goal: cross-cloud examples (aws/gcp) and a short ops runbook. Who can own the scaffolding?

josh-eng: I can scaffold the repo. Plan: modules/ (network, cluster, inference, kms), examples/ (aws, gcp), docs/ (arch.md, runbook.md), ci/ (pipeline templates). Important: modules must not include provider {} blocks. Standard vars: region, project, cluster_name, routing_mode.

priya-arch: Constraints to remember: 1) support both dedicated and hosted routing paths, 2) optional HSM fallback, 3) firewall rules for private VPCs. I'll drop a basic arch sketch into docs/arch.md with a minimal sequence diagram.

sam-terraform: I'll open the module scaffolding PR tomorrow EOD. Checklist per module: variables.tf, outputs.tf, README.md with usage, small example. Example main.tf snippet for the top-level wiring:

```
module "network" {
  source = "../modules/network"
  name   = "cvx-net"
  region = var.region
}
module "cluster" {
  source     = "../modules/cluster"
  network_id = module.network.id
  cluster_name = "cvx-demo"
}
module "inference" {
  source       = "../modules/inference"
  cluster_name = module.cluster.name
  routing_mode = var.routing_mode
  enable_hsm   = var.enable_hsm
}
```
\nci-bot: CI template created: https://ci.internal/redwood/cvx-iac (tfsec + unit tests) :white_check_mark:\n\nada-partnerships: great. Timeline: scaffolding PR by sam, josh to add outputs lint rule to repo template, priya to add arch diagram + security checklist in docs/arch.md. Review on Thursday 10am PT. Action items noted. :calendar:
